summary: Iteration 15: Verified supplier CRUD after PostgreSQL fix. All 6 backend tests passed (create/list/get/update/delete + Lightspeed regression: test connection connected=true, categories returned 50+). Frontend Suppliers page loaded, created a new supplier via the form, toast 'Supplier created' shown and item appeared in the list. Supplier save bug is resolved.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (radix). Non-blocking but should be fixed for accessibility.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Suppliers Add/Edit dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/suppliers.py create_supplier returns only {id, message} but the test file test_supplier_crud.py (older iteration 12) expects supplier_name/status/services in the response - inconsistent. Consider returning the full inserted row for a better DX.
POST /api/suppliers does not check for duplicate supplier_name (schema likely has no unique constraint). Could allow duplicate entries.

update_supplier builds SQL dynamically but never handles the case where update_fields has only updated_at (still executes UPDATE with just timestamp - fine, but silent no-op if user posts empty body).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_Iter15_* suppliers via fixtures. One UI-created supplier TEST_UI_1786137058 may still exist and can be safely deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL supplier bug fully fixed. Auth uses /api/auth/login returning access_token; all supplier routes require Bearer token (admin role for POST/PUT/DELETE). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported when running pytest locally as the .env is not auto-loaded by tests.
rca of the issue: Original bug 'failed to save supplier' was due to PostgreSQL crashing between sessions and _ensure_postgresql() not recreating the user/database when PG restarted. Fix in server.py now always verifies user+DB exist regardless of PG running state. Confirmed by successful POST/PUT/DELETE against live PG-backed API.
